描述_ZN: Page of "Waterfowl with Red Polygonum", Song Dynasty, fan page, silk, color, 25.2 cm long, 26.8 cm wide.　　There is no mark on this page. Inscriptions: "True Appreciation", "Seal of Duoyu Geng Xinguang's Painting and Calligraphy", "Gong", "Xinguang's Precious Appreciation", "Dancheng", "Yi'er", "Yil", "Dancheng", "Yi'er sons and grandsons", "Hanshui Geng Huihou seal of calligraphy and painting", "Shu Liu master", "Chen Ding", "Chen Ding" and "Chen Ding", "Chen Ding", "Xiang Zijing Family Collection", "Mo Lin Secret Play", and "Pang Lai Chen Collection of Song and Yuan Genuine Works". Inscription on the edge of the frame reads "Collection of the Supervisor of the Lord Xin".　　The picture depicts a branch of red polygonum at the water's edge with small flowers in full bloom. The water bird finds a shrimp in the wave and flies quietly down to the red polygonum branch, pecking it with its beak. The red polygonum is bent by the water bird's weight and stirring force, and the tips and leaf tips are submerged in the water. The shrimp swims nimbly in the water, oblivious to the danger they face. This thrilling moment in nature is cleverly incorporated into the silk, making it extremely vivid and evocative. The waterfowl and the red polygonum are brightly colored and finely drawn. The delicate feathers of the birds are clearly countable, and even the cornucopia of the polygonum flowers are meticulously colored in purple and pink and white, with distinct layers. The shrimps and water lilies in the water are blurred and colored in a single color of light ink green, similar to the painting method. Thus, although the water is not painted, the two boundaries between water and drought are clearly defined.　　The opposite panel is inscribed by Geng Zhaozhong: "The writing of the objects is so businesslike that Xu Chongji not only does not fall short of his ancestral style, but also can lead future generations. Xiangping Geng Zhaozhong inscription." 　　Exists in the "famous brush set victory" book. Recorded in "Xuzhai famous paintings".
